datasets.name: 3c6ecd64
queryLines:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    subevent_code,
    country_code,
    country_name,
    ranked_player_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subevent_code ORDER BY ranked_player_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.v_federation_scorecard
  WHERE ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
)
SELECT subevent_code, rn AS rank, country_code, country_name, ranked_player_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY
  CASE subevent_code
    WHEN 'MS'  THEN 1
    WHEN 'WS'  THEN 2
    WHEN 'MD'  THEN 3
    WHEN 'MDI' THEN 4
    WHEN 'WD'  THEN 5
    WHEN 'WDI' THEN 6
    WHEN 'XD'  THEN 7
    WHEN 'XDI' THEN 8
    ELSE 99
  END,
  rn;

    WHEN 'MS' THEN 1

    WHEN 'MDI' THEN 4
    WHEN 'WD' THEN 5
    WHEN 'WDI' THEN 6
    WHEN 'XD' THEN 7
    WHEN 'XDI' THEN 8
    ELSE 99
  END

datasets.name: top_risers
queryLines:
SELECT
  player_name,
  country_code,
  subevent_code,
  previous_rank,
  current_rank,
  previous_rank - current_rank AS ranking_difference
FROM
  wttrankingsbi.gold.v_ranking_movers
WHERE
  ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
  AND previous_rank - current_rank > 0
ORDER BY
  previous_rank - current_rank DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: trend_doubles_ind
queryLines:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_ittfid, '\\(([0-9]+)\\)', 1), '121558') AS pid
),
gc AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN 'MDI'
      ELSE 'WDI'
    END AS code
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.dim_player dp
      JOIN params p
        ON dp.ittfid = p.pid
),
li AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) AS mk
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual
  WHERE
    ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
)
SELECT
  f.ranking_year,
  f.ranking_week,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(f.ranking_year AS STRING),
    ' W',
    LPAD(CAST(f.ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0')
  ) AS period_label,
  f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week AS period_key,
  f.current_rank,
  f.ranking_points_ytd AS ranking_points,
  (f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = l.mk AS is_current_week,
  ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = MAX(f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) OVER ()) AND ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) != l.mk) AS is_last_ranked,
  CASE
    WHEN (f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = l.mk THEN
      CONCAT('Current — Rank #', CAST(f.current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(f.ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(f.ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    WHEN ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = MAX(f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) OVER ()) AND ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) != l.mk) THEN
      CONCAT('Last Ranked — Rank #', CAST(f.current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(f.ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(f.ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
  END AS current_annotation
FROM
  wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual f
    JOIN params p
      ON f.ittfid = p.pid
    JOIN gc g
      ON f.subevent_code = g.code
    CROSS JOIN li l
WHERE
  f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
  AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  f.ranking_year,
  f.ranking_week

AS pk FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual f WHERE f.ittfid = ( SELECT pid FROM params ) AND f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL ), ind_curr AS ( SELECT subevent_code, current_rank AS cr FROM ind_all WHERE pk = ( SELECT mk FROM li ) ), ind_best AS ( SELECT subevent_code, cr, ry, rw FROM ( SELECT subevent_code, current_rank AS cr, ranking_year AS ry, ranking_week AS rw, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY subevent_code ORDER BY current_rank, ranking_year, ranking_week ) AS rn FROM ind_all ) t WHERE rn = 1 ), my_pairs AS ( SELECT dpr.ittfid AS pair_id, 100 + ranking_week) AS mk FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair WHERE ranking_run_code = 'SEN' ), pair_curr AS ( SELECT mp.subevent_code, MIN(f.current_rank) AS cr FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair f JOIN my_pairs mp ON f.ittfid = mp.pair_id WHERE f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week = ( SELECT mk FROM lp ) GROUP BY mp.subevent_code ), pair_best AS ( SELECT subevent_code, cr, ry, rw FROM ( SELECT mp.subevent_code, f.current_rank AS cr, f.ranking_year AS ry, f.ranking_week AS rw, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY mp.subevent_code ORDER BY f.current_rank, f.ranking_year, f.ranking_week ) AS rn FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair f JOIN my_pairs mp ON f.ittfid = mp.pair_id WHERE f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT p.pid AS ittfid, pl.player_name, pl.glabel AS gender_label, l.ly AS latest_year, l.lw AS latest_week, CONCAT( 'Player ', pl.player_name, ' (ITTF ID ', p.pid, ') Performance as of ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING), ' Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0') ) AS page_title, CONCAT( 'ITTF ID ', p.pid, ' | Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING) ) AS subtitle, CONCAT( '
', pl.player_name, '
ITTF ID ', p.pid, ' | Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING), '
View Player Profile
' ) AS header_html, CONCAT('https://www.worldtabletennis.com/playerDescription?playerId=', p.pid) AS profile_url, CONCAT( 'https://photofiles.worldtabletennis.com/wtt-media/photos/400px/', p.pid, '_HEADSHOT_R_', CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(pl.player_name, ' ', 1) = UPPER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pl.player_name, ' ', 1)) THEN REPLACE(pl.player_name, ' ', '_') ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pl.player_name, ' ', -1), '_', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pl.player_name, ' ', 1)) END, '.png' ) AS image_url, CONCAT( '
' ) AS image_html, 'View Player Profile' AS profile_link_text, CONCAT( '', pl.player_name, '' ) AS profile_link_html, CONCAT(pl.glabel, ' Singles Ranking') AS singles_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(s_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS singles_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS singles_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(s_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS singles_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(s_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(s_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS singles_best_period, CONCAT(pl.glabel, ' Doubles Ranking') AS doubles_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(d_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doubles_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS doubles_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(d_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doubles_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(d_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(d_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS doubles_best_period, CONCAT(pl.glabel, ' Doubles Individual Ranking') AS doublesind_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(di_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doublesind_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS doublesind_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(di_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doublesind_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(di_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(di_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS doublesind_best_period, 'Mixed Doubles Ranking' AS xd_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(xd_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS xd_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), datasets.name: trend_doubles
queryLines:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_ittfid, '\\(([0-9]+)\\)', 1), '121558') AS pid
),
gc AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN 'MD'
      ELSE 'WD'
    END AS code
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.dim_player dp
      JOIN params p
        ON dp.ittfid = p.pid
),
my_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    dpr.ittfid AS pair_id
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.dim_pair dpr
      JOIN params p
        ON (
          dpr.partner1_ittfid = p.pid
          OR dpr.partner2_ittfid = p.pid
        )
      JOIN gc g
        ON dpr.subevent_code = g.code
),
lp AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) AS mk
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair
  WHERE
    ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
),
raw_data AS (
  SELECT
    f.ranking_year,
    f.ranking_week,
    f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week AS period_key,
    f.current_rank,
    f.points AS ranking_points,
    (f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = l.mk AS is_current_week
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair f
      JOIN my_pairs mp
        ON f.ittfid = mp.pair_id
      CROSS JOIN lp l
  WHERE
    f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
    AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL
),
best_per_week AS (
  SELECT
    ranking_year,
    ranking_week,
    period_key,
    MIN(current_rank) AS current_rank,
    MAX(ranking_points) AS ranking_points,
    BOOL_OR(is_current_week) AS is_current_week
  FROM
    raw_data
  GROUP BY
    ranking_year,
    ranking_week,
    period_key
)
SELECT
  ranking_year,
  ranking_week,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(ranking_year AS STRING),
    ' W',
    LPAD(CAST(ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0')
  ) AS period_label,
  period_key,
  current_rank,
  ranking_points,
  (period_key = MAX(period_key) OVER ()) AND (period_key = (SELECT mk FROM lp)) AS is_current_week,
  (period_key = MAX(period_key) OVER ()) AND (period_key != (SELECT mk FROM lp)) AS is_last_ranked,
  CASE
    WHEN (period_key = MAX(period_key) OVER ()) AND (period_key = (SELECT mk FROM lp)) THEN
      CONCAT('Current — Rank #', CAST(current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    WHEN (period_key = MAX(period_key) OVER ()) AND (period_key != (SELECT mk FROM lp)) THEN
      CONCAT('Last Ranked — Rank #', CAST(current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
  END AS current_annotation
FROM
  best_per_week
ORDER BY
  ranking_year,
  ranking_week

      CONCAT('Last Ranked — Rank #', CAST(current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
  END AS current_annotation
FROM
  best_per_week
ORDER BY
  ranking_year,
  ranking_week

datasets.name: trend_singles
queryLines:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_ittfid, '\\(([0-9]+)\\)', 1), '121558') AS pid
),
gc AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN 'MS'
      ELSE 'WS'
    END AS code
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.dim_player dp
      JOIN params p
        ON dp.ittfid = p.pid
),
li AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) AS mk
  FROM
    wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual
  WHERE
    ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
)
SELECT
  f.ranking_year,
  f.ranking_week,
  CONCAT(
    CAST(f.ranking_year AS STRING),
    ' W',
    LPAD(CAST(f.ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0')
  ) AS period_label,
  f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week AS period_key,
  f.current_rank,
  f.ranking_points_ytd AS ranking_points,
  (f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = l.mk AS is_current_week,
  ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = MAX(f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) OVER ()) AND ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) != l.mk) AS is_last_ranked,
  CASE
    WHEN (f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = l.mk THEN
      CONCAT('Current — Rank #', CAST(f.current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(f.ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(f.ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
    WHEN ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) = MAX(f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) OVER ()) AND ((f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week) != l.mk) THEN
      CONCAT('Last Ranked — Rank #', CAST(f.current_rank AS STRING), ' | ', CAST(f.ranking_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(f.ranking_week AS STRING), 2, '0'))
  END AS current_annotation
FROM
  wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual f
    JOIN params p
      ON f.ittfid = p.pid
    JOIN gc g
      ON f.subevent_code = g.code
    CROSS JOIN li l
WHERE
  f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
  AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  f.ranking_year,
  f.ranking_week

datasets.name: player_cards
queryLines:
WITH params AS ( SELECT COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_ittfid, '\\(([0-9]+)\\)', 1), '121558') AS pid ), player AS ( SELECT dp.ittfid, dp.player_name, CASE WHEN UPPER(dp.gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN CONCAT('Men', chr(39), 's') ELSE CONCAT('Women', chr(39), 's') END AS glabel, CASE WHEN UPPER(dp.gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN 'MS' ELSE 'WS' END AS s_code, CASE WHEN UPPER(dp.gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN 'MD' ELSE 'WD' END AS d_code, CASE WHEN UPPER(dp.gender) LIKE 'M%' THEN 'MDI' ELSE 'WDI' END AS di_code FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.dim_player dp WHERE dp.ittfid = ( SELECT pid FROM params ) ), li AS ( SELECT MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) AS mk, CAST(MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) / 100 AS INT) AS ly, CAST(MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) % 100 AS INT) AS lw FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual WHERE ranking_run_code = 'SEN' ), ind_all AS ( SELECT f.subevent_code, f.current_rank, f.ranking_year, f.ranking_week, f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week AS pk FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_individual f WHERE f.ittfid = ( SELECT pid FROM params ) AND f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL ), ind_curr AS ( SELECT subevent_code, current_rank AS cr FROM ind_all WHERE pk = ( SELECT mk FROM li ) ), ind_best AS ( SELECT subevent_code, cr, ry, rw FROM ( SELECT subevent_code, current_rank AS cr, ranking_year AS ry, ranking_week AS rw, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY subevent_code ORDER BY current_rank, ranking_year, ranking_week ) AS rn FROM ind_all ) t WHERE rn = 1 ), my_pairs AS ( SELECT dpr.ittfid AS pair_id, dpr.subevent_code FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.dim_pair dpr WHERE dpr.partner1_ittfid = ( SELECT pid FROM params ) OR dpr.partner2_ittfid = ( SELECT pid FROM params ) ), lp AS ( SELECT MAX(ranking_year * 100 + ranking_week) AS mk FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair WHERE ranking_run_code = 'SEN' ), pair_curr AS ( SELECT mp.subevent_code, MIN(f.current_rank) AS cr FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair f JOIN my_pairs mp ON f.ittfid = mp.pair_id WHERE f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND f.ranking_year * 100 + f.ranking_week = ( SELECT mk FROM lp ) GROUP BY mp.subevent_code ), pair_best AS ( SELECT subevent_code, cr, ry, rw FROM ( SELECT mp.subevent_code, f.current_rank AS cr, f.ranking_year AS ry, f.ranking_week AS rw, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY mp.subevent_code ORDER BY f.current_rank, f.ranking_year, f.ranking_week ) AS rn FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.fact_ranking_pair f JOIN my_pairs mp ON f.ittfid = mp.pair_id WHERE f.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND f.current_rank IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT CONCAT(pl.glabel, ' Singles Ranking') AS singles_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(s_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS singles_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS singles_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(s_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS singles_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(s_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(s_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS singles_best_period, CONCAT(pl.glabel, ' Doubles Ranking') AS doubles_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(d_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doubles_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS doubles_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(d_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doubles_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(d_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(d_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS doubles_best_period, CONCAT(pl.glabel, ' Doubles Individual Ranking') AS doublesind_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(di_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doublesind_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS doublesind_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(di_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS doublesind_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(di_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(di_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS doublesind_best_period, 'Mixed Doubles Ranking' AS xd_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(xd_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS xd_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS xd_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(xd_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS xd_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(xd_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(xd_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS xd_best_period, 'Mixed Doubles Individual Ranking' AS xdi_label, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(xdi_curr.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS xdi_current_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(l.lw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(l.ly AS STRING)), '' ) AS xdi_current_period, COALESCE(CONCAT('#', CAST(xdi_best.cr AS STRING)), 'NONE') AS xdi_best_rank, COALESCE( CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(xdi_best.rw AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(xdi_best.ry AS STRING)), '' ) AS xdi_best_period, CONCAT( '
' ) AS image_html FROM params p LEFT JOIN player pl ON TRUE LEFT JOIN li l ON TRUE LEFT JOIN ind_curr s_curr ON s_curr.subevent_code = pl.s_code LEFT JOIN ind_best s_best ON s_best.subevent_code = pl.s_code LEFT JOIN pair_curr d_curr ON d_curr.subevent_code = pl.d_code LEFT JOIN pair_best d_best ON d_best.subevent_code = pl.d_code LEFT JOIN ind_curr di_curr ON di_curr.subevent_code = pl.di_code LEFT JOIN ind_best di_best ON di_best.subevent_code = pl.di_code LEFT JOIN pair_curr xd_curr ON xd_curr.subevent_code = 'XD' LEFT JOIN pair_best xd_best ON xd_best.subevent_code = 'XD' LEFT JOIN ind_curr xdi_curr ON xdi_curr.subevent_code = 'XDI' LEFT JOIN ind_best xdi_best ON xdi_best.subevent_code = 'XDI'

datasets.name: 6ef701f4
queryLines:
SELECT
  ranking_year,
  ranking_week,
  updated_at,
  CONCAT('Week ', ranking_week, ', ', ranking_year) AS week_label,
  ROUND(
    (unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(updated_at)) / 3600.0,
    1
  ) AS hours_ago,
  total_minutes,
  TRIM(
    CONCAT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          FLOOR(total_minutes / 1440) >= 1
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            CAST(FLOOR(total_minutes / 1440) AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN FLOOR(total_minutes / 1440) = 1 THEN ' day '
              ELSE ' days '
            END
          )
        ELSE ''
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN
          FLOOR((total_minutes % 1440) / 60) >= 1
        THEN
          CONCAT(CAST(FLOOR((total_minutes % 1440) / 60) AS STRING), 'hrs ')
        ELSE ''
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN (total_minutes % 60) >= 1 THEN CONCAT(CAST(total_minutes % 60 AS STRING), 'min')
        ELSE ''
      END
    )
  ) AS duration_label,
  DATE_FORMAT(from_utc_timestamp(updated_at, 'Asia/Singapore'), 'MMM d, yyyy h:mm a') AS updated_at_label
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      *,
      CAST(
        FLOOR((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(updated_at)) / 60.0) AS INT
      ) AS total_minutes
    FROM
      wttrankingsbi.control.batch_control
    WHERE
      status = 'gold_done'
    ORDER BY
      ranking_year DESC,
      ranking_week DESC
    LIMIT 1

datasets.name: pair_options
queryLines:
-- Labels carry a sortable prefix so the drop-down reads in rank order even if the
-- filter sorts values alphabetically: '#00000' = auto (current #1), '#00007' = ranked 7th
-- this week, '~' = not ranked this week. Selection only reads the trailing '(<id>)'.
SELECT display_label, subevent_label, subevent_code, sort_order
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    '#00000 · Top-ranked pair (auto)' AS display_label,
    subevent_label,
    subevent_code,
    0 AS sort_order
  FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.v_pair_profile
  WHERE ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN current_rank IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('#', LPAD(CAST(current_rank AS STRING), 5, '0'), ' · ', display_label)
      ELSE CONCAT('~ ', display_label)
    END AS display_label,
    subevent_label,
    subevent_code,
    sort_order
  FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.v_pair_profile
  WHERE ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
) t
ORDER BY subevent_code, sort_order

Pair ITTF ID ', pr.pair_ittfid, ' | ', CONCAT('Week ', LPAD(CAST(pr.latest_week AS STRING), 2, '0'), ', ', CAST(pr.latest_year AS STRING)), '

datasets.name: pair_trend
queryLines:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_subevent, '\\(([A-Z]+)\\)$', 1), ''), 'MD') AS sub,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_pair, '\\(([0-9]+)\\)$', 1), '') AS raw_pid
),
pick AS (
  -- selected pair if it belongs to the selected subevent, else that subevent's top-ranked pair
  SELECT o.pair_ittfid AS pid, o.subevent_code AS sub
  FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.v_pair_profile o
  CROSS JOIN sel
  WHERE o.ranking_run_code = 'SEN' AND o.subevent_code = sel.sub
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.pair_ittfid = sel.raw_pid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, o.sort_order
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  h.period_label,
  h.period_key,
  h.period_date,
  h.current_rank,
  h.ranking_points,
  h.is_current_week,
  h.is_last_ranked,
  h.current_annotation
FROM wttrankingsbi.gold.v_pair_ranking_history h
JOIN pick k ON h.pair_ittfid = k.pid AND h.subevent_code = k.sub
WHERE h.ranking_run_code = 'SEN'

datasets.name: pair_leaderboard
queryLines:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_subevent, '\\(([A-Z]+)\\)$', 1), ''), 'MD') AS sub,
    NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_pair, '\\(([0-9]+)\\)$', 1), '') AS raw_pid
),
pick AS (
  -- selected pair if it belongs to the selected subevent, else that subevent's top-ranked pair

SELECT
  l.current_rank,
  l.pair_name,
  l.pair_ittfid,
  l.federations,
  CAST(ROUND(l.current_points) AS INT) AS points,
  l.movement_label,

queryLines:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:p_subevent, '\\(([A-Z]+)\\)$', 1), ''), 'MD') AS sub
)
SELECT
  p.pair_name,
  CONCAT_WS(' / ', p.partner1_country_code, p.partner2_country_code) AS federations,
  p.weeks_ranked,
  p.weeks_in_top10,
  p.best_rank,
  CONCAT(CAST(p.first_ranked_year AS STRING), ' W', LPAD(CAST(p.first_ranked_week AS STRING), 2, '0')) AS ranked_since,

WHERE p.ranking_run_code = 'SEN'
